basis.selection_reason: 011 执行与比较成功，使用该表已验证日期；优先 010 同题候选 / 共同兼容日，再按日期升序
basis.value_representation: Unmodified DuckDB CAST AS VARCHAR; SQL NULL is JSON null. Keys use the unchanged historical L0 normalization.

edits.new: CAST(CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(campaign_bidding_strategy)) IN ('advanced cpc', 'enhanced cpc', 'manual cpc', 'manual cpm', 'target impression share bids', 'maximize conversions', 'maximize conversion value', 'target cpa', 'target roas', 'viewable cpm', 'target cpm', 'commission', 'percent cpc') THEN UPPER(TRIM(campaign_bidding_strategy)) ELSE NULL END AS TEXT) AS campaign_bidding_strategy

CAST(CASE WHEN impressions IS NULL OR impressions < 0 THEN 0.0 WHEN clicks IS NULL OR clicks < 0 THEN 0.0 WHEN impressions > 0 THEN ROUND((CAST(clicks AS DECIMAL(18, 3)) / CAST(impressions AS DECIMAL(18, 3))) * 100, 4) ELSE 0.0 END AS DOUBLE) AS click_through_rate
CAST(CASE WHEN clicks IS NULL OR clicks <= 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE ROUND(ROUND(CASE WHEN cost IS NULL THEN 0.0 WHEN cost < 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE cost END, 2) / clicks, 2) END AS DOUBLE) AS cost_per_click

edits.old: CAST(TRY_CAST("ad_group_id" AS VARCHAR) AS VARCHAR) AS ad_group_id
edits.new: CAST(CASE WHEN TRIM(CAST(ad_group_id AS TEXT)) = '' OR ad_group_id IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN NOT REGEXP_MATCHES(TRIM(CAST(ad_group_id AS TEXT)), '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}$') THEN NULL ELSE TRIM(CAST(ad_group_id AS TEXT)) END AS TEXT) AS ad_group_id
SELECT * FROM cleaned WHERE ad_group_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(ad_group_id) != '' AND regexp_matches(ad_group_id, '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}$')
